body:
Wobble Mod adds a subtle but immersive camera jolt effect to your Minecraft experience. Every so often, your camera will twitch in a random direction and snap back, simulating the feeling of a head movement, lag spike, or nervous twitch.
Features:

Randomly triggers every 5 to 60 seconds — you never know when the next one is coming
Each jolt is unique — random direction, random size, and random speed
Occasional double stutters for extra unpredictability
Fully visible to other players on servers — your character's head actually moves
Simple toggle with G to turn it on or off whenever you want
